title: Why deals are lost
transcript:
Consultant: When a deal is lost, what gets recorded?
Client: The stage moves to closed lost and that is the end of it.
Consultant: No reason captured?
Client: Nothing structured. Sales leadership wants a loss reason on the
opportunity, a picklist with price, timing, competitor and no decision.
Consultant: Four options.
Client: Four. They argued about it for a month, so please do not add a fifth.

expected.note: Picklist on Opportunity; the four values are explicitly agreed.
